name: Ecology
summary: How organisms interact with each other and their environment, at the scale of individuals, populations, communities, ecosystems and the biosphere.

topics.name: Scope of ecology and levels of ecological study
Climate, the physical environment and the distribution of life
Organisms and their environment: tolerance, niches and adaptation
Population ecology basics: density, dispersion, growth
Species interactions: competition, predation, herbivory, parasitism, mutualism
Ecosystems: energy flow, trophic levels and productivity
Biogeochemical cycles: carbon, nitrogen, phosphorus, water
